insights.one_liner: A Dutch dredging and marine engineering giant based in Papendrecht, building ports, coastal defences and offshore wind infrastructure worldwide.

culture.text: Staff often studied civil, mechanical or maritime engineering, with TU Delft, Rotterdam UAS and Avans among the top schools.
It has over 11,000 employees, about 400 vessels and works in 70 countries.
Its salvage arm SMIT Salvage is one of the largest in the world and responds to ships in trouble at sea.

open.text: Baggermaatschappij Boskalis B.V. and Boskalis Subsea Cables B.V. are IND recognised sponsors.
Its two current internships in Papendrecht (marketing and data) are open to non-Dutch speakers.

growth.text: It won a contract to lay 149 km of cable for 69 turbines at the Zeevonk offshore wind farm off IJmuiden.
A Boskalis-Van Oord joint venture won a US$580 million dredging contract to expand Sweden's Luleå port.

worth_knowing.text: Boskalis warns of fake job offers in its name: if anyone asks you to pay for a job or visa, it is fraud.
Dura Vermeer wants to take over Boskalis Nederland's stakes in three asphalt plants.
